scope: Single revised identity proposal, not a replacement five-model range.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one isolated HEADLESS full-body outfit module for an original cyberpunk roguelike character, final game cell 64x64.
Subject: a Technomancien, an almost fully robotic human technician who controls drones and combat algorithms. Build a NEW distinctive machine-technician silhouette around a long straight-cut industrial work coat. The coat is the main readable shape: broad continuous medium petrol-TEAL front panels from shoulders to mid-calves, squared stiff hem split at the front, a visible dark central opening. A low raised angular charcoal work collar. One flat dark rectangular control unit at the chest with a single broad amber bar. Large simple copper/brass robotic forearms emerging from the coat sleeves; one rectangular control cuff on one forearm, the other a plain prosthetic hand. Hands low and empty, grouped into clear simple mechanical mitts. Two big dark mechanical boots with one broad brass toe cap each. Short dark exposed shins. A compact slightly stooped technical-worker posture, narrow sloping shoulders, coat widening toward the hem. Two arms and two legs only.
READABILITY FIRST: the WHOLE module will be only 48 pixels tall. Use very few large flat shapes, a strong continuous outer contour, 2-3 broad shade values per material, clean negative spaces between arms and coat, and separated feet. No thin skeletal struts, no visible ribcage grid, no circular joint rings scattered everywhere, no tiny finger segments, no clusters of lights. At thumbnail size it must read as a teal coated machine-technician with large warm metal prosthetic hands and boots. Main color masses: medium teal coat, warm brass prosthetics, charcoal mechanical recesses. Teal must be bright enough to separate from dark grey flooring. Mechanical body is conveyed by the large prosthetic forearms and boots, not by dozens of tiny joints.
Entire body from a SHORT dark robotic neck stump to both full soles, centered and front-facing, approximately 30 pixels wide for a 48 pixel body height. Keep the neck stump exactly on the vertical body center line; a separate fixed head will be added later. NO HEAD OR FACE, hood or helmet. No weapon, handheld tool, drone, extra arm, tentacle, cape, staff, glowing aura or ground shadow. No ivory chest carapace, bulky battle shoulder pads, separate white thigh armor, or muscle-shaped warrior plating. The coat is stiff industrial protective wear, not flowing wizard robes. No skull symbols, licensed emblems, text or labels.
Style: original matte hand-painted game sprite with crisp readable masses and dark intentional outline, simple overhead-left lighting. No photographic texture, fine scratches, rivets, filigree, dense cables or decorative seams. No detailed concept illustration; all detail must survive a 64x64 cell.
One full isolated body, generous transparent margins. Genuinely transparent background with alpha zero everywhere outside the character; no vignette, grey halo or studio backdrop.
